_comment: DEFAULT CONFIGURATION - All sensors visible, no filtering
_comment2: Copy this file to config.json to restore defaults
_comment3: Or use as reference when customizing config.json

defaultTimeRange._comment: Initial time range when page loads

colors._comment: Chart line colors (hex format). Cycles through if more sensors than colors

zoom._comment: Zoom and pan behavior (wheel, drag, pinch)

sensorFilter._comment: Filter which sensors to display (DISABLED - shows all sensors)
